name: chasehorse-outreach
description: Lead discovery, research, qualification and outreach platform for ChaseHorse

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c gray,yellow "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npx --prefix frontend tsc -p frontend --noEmit
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
